canon.note: Tingyun (Lightning, Harmony). Basic 120201 Dislodged (A4 trace: +40% DMG). Skill 120202 Soothing Melody: grants Benediction to a single ally (ATK bonus = % of target ATK, capped by Tingyun's ATK) for 3 turns; the Benediction ally deals Lightning Additional DMG on every attack (once per attack). Skill also gives Tingyun A2 +20% SPD for 1 turn. Ultimate 120204 Violet Sparknado: target ally regenerates 50 Energy (60 at E6) and gains +DMG for 2 turns. A6 Jubilant Passage: +5 Energy at the start of Tingyun's turn. Talent Violet Sparknado: when Tingyun hits an enemy the Benediction ally adds Lightning DMG. Energy 130.

requirements.claim: Basic ATK Dislodged (A4 +40%) (120201, Thunder) is the kit's Basic and fires in the fixture.
Skill Soothing Melody (120202) fires as a Skill action (decide harmony.ts:653-656 prefers Skill while SP >= 1).
Violet Sparknado (120204) fires once Energy reaches 130 (energyMax harmony.ts:645).
Skill places Benediction on an ally (harmony.ts:625-638, atkFlat buff).
A2 Nourished Joviality gives Tingyun +20% SPD for 1 turn after her Skill (harmony.ts:684-685).
Violet Sparknado grants the target ally a +DMG buff for 2 turns (harmony.ts:672-675).
Violet Sparknado regenerates 50 Energy to the Benediction ally at E0 (harmony.ts:671); the regen is capped by the target's max Energy, so the nominal amount is asserted from the cast log.
The Benediction ally deals Lightning Additional DMG on its attacks (harmony.ts:710-713, 'Soothing Melody').
A6 Jubilant Passage grants +5 Energy at the start of Tingyun's turn (harmony.ts:647-650).
The Skill action starts before Benediction is placed (harmony.ts:682 then 688).
E1 Windfall of Lucky Springs grants the Ult target +20% SPD for 1 turn (harmony.ts:676).
